verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Dhaalikal-kitaabu laa rayba feehi hudan lilmuttaqeen
Al-ladheena yu'minoona bil-ghaybi wa yuqeemoonas-salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal-ladheena yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilayka wa maa unzila min qablika wa bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
Ulaa'ika alaa hudan min rabbihim wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo sawaa'un alayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhirhum laa yu'minoon
Khatama Allaahu alaa quloobihim wa alaa sam'ihim wa alaa absaarihim ghishaawatun wa lahum adhaabun azeem
Wa minan-naasi man yaqoolu aamannaa Billaahi wa bil-yawmil-aakhiri wa maa hum bimu'mineen
Yukhaadi'oona Allaaha wal-ladheena aamanoo wa maa yakhda'oona illaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
Fee quloobihim maradun fazaadahumu Allaahu maradan wa lahum adhaabun aleemun bimaa kaanoo yakdhiboon
Wa idhaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil-ardi qaaloo innamaa nahnu muslihoon
Alaa innahum humul-mufsidoona wa laakin laa yash'uroon
Wa idhaa qeela lahum aaminoo kamaa aamanan-naasu qaaloo anu'minu kamaa aamanas-sufahaa'u alaa innahum humus-sufahaa'u wa laakin laa ya'lamoon
Wa idhaa laqul-ladheena aamanoo qaaloo aamannaa wa idhaa khalaw ilaa shayaateenihim qaaloo innaa ma'akum innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
Allaahu yastahzi'u bihim wa yamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena ishtaraw ad-dalaalata bil-hudaa famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen
Mathaluhum kamathalil-ladhee istawqada naaran falammaa adaa'at maa hawlahu dhahaba Allaahu binoorihim wa tarakahum fee zulumaatin laa yubsiroon
Summun bukmun umyun fahum laa yarji'oon
Aw kasayyibin minas-samaa'i feehi zulumaatun wa ra'dun wa barqun yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum fee aadhaanihim minas-sawaa'iqi hadharal-mawti Wallaahu muheetun bil-kaafireen
Yakaadul-barqu yakhtafu absaarahum kullamaa adaa'a lahum mashaw feehi wa idhaa azlama alayhim qaamoo wa law shaa'a Allaahu ladhahaba bisam'ihim wa absaarihim innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu u'budoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum wal-ladheena min qablikum la-allakum tattaqoon
Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda firaashan was-samaa'a binaa'an wa anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-akhraja bihi minath-thamaraati rizqan lakum falaa taj'aloo Lillaahi andaadan wa antum ta'lamoon
Wa in kuntum fee raybin mimmaa nazzalnaa alaa abdinaa fa'too bisooratin min mithlihi wad'oo shuhadaa'akum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa-in lam taf'aloo wa lan taf'aloo fattaqun-naaral-latee waqooduhan-naasu wal-hijaaratu u'iddat lilkaafireen

Wa bashshiril-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati anna lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru kullamaa ruziqoo minhaa min thamaratin rizqan qaaloo haadhal-ladhee ruziqnaa min qablu wa utoo bihi mutashaabihan wa lahum feehaa azwaajun mutahharatun wa hum feehaa khaalidoon

Innallaaha laa yastahyee an yadriba mathalan maa ba'oodatan famaa fawqahaa fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo faya'lamoona annahul-haqqu min rabbihim wa ammal-ladheena kafaroo fayaqooloona maadhaa araada Allaahu bihadhaa mathalan yudillu bihi katheeran wa yahdee bihi katheeran wa maa yudillu bihi illal-faasiqeen
Al-ladheena yanqudoona ahda Allaahi min ba'di meethaaqihi wa yaqta'oona maa amara Allaahu bihi an yoosala wa yufsidoona fil-ardi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Kayfa takfuroona Billaahi wa kuntum amwaatan fa-ahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma ilayhi turja'oon
Huwal-ladhee khalaqa lakum maa fil-ardi jamee'an thumma istawaa ilas-samaa'i fasawwaahunna sab'a samaawaatin wa huwa bikulli shay'in aleem

Wa idh qaala rabbuka lilmalaa'ikati innee jaa'ilun fil-ardi khaleefatan qaaloo ataj'alu feehaa man yufsidu feehaa wa yasfikud-dimaa'a wa nahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wa nuqaddisu laka qaala innee a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa allama aadamal-asmaa'a kullahaa thumma aradahum alal-malaa'ikati faqaala anbi'oonee bi-asmaa'i haa'ulaa'i in kuntum saadiqeen
Qaaloo subhaanaka laa ilma lanaa illaa maa allamtanaa innaka antal-aleemul-hakeem
Qaala yaa aadamu anbi'hum bi-asmaa'ihim falammaa anba'ahum bi-asmaa'ihim qaala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal-ardi wa a'lamu maa tubdoona wa maa kuntum taktumoon
Wa idh qulnaa lilmalaa'ikati usjudoo li'dama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa abaa wastakbara wa kaana minal-kaafireen
Wa qulnaa yaa aadamu uskun anta wa zawjukal-jannata wa kulaa minhaa raghadan haythu shi'tumaa wa laa taqrabaa haadhihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaalimeen
Fa-azallahumash-shaytaanu anhaa fa-akhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa feehi wa qulnaa ihbitoo ba'dukum liba'din aduwwun wa lakum fil-ardi mustaqarrun wa mataa'un ilaa heen
Fatalaqqaa aadamu min rabbihi kalimaatin fataaba alayhi innahu huwat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Qulnaa ihbitoo minhaa jamee'an fa-immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabi'a hudaaya falaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Yaa banee israa'eela udhkuroo ni'matiyal-latee an'amtu alaykum wa awfoo bi-ahdee oofi bi-ahdikum wa iyyaaya farhaboon
Wa aaminoo bimaa anzaltu musaddiqan limaa ma'akum wa laa takoonoo awwala kaafirin bihi wa laa tashtaroo bi-aayaatee thamanan qaleelan wa iyyaaya fattaqoon
Wa laa talbisul-haqqa bil-baatili wa taktumul-haqqa wa antum ta'lamoon
Wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata warka'oo ma'ar-raaki'een
Ata'muroonan-naasa bil-birri wa tansawna anfusakum wa antum tatloonal-kitaaba afalaa ta'qiloon
Wasta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salaati wa innahaa lakabeeratun illaa alal-khaashi'een
Al-ladheena yazunnoona annahum mulaaqoo rabbihim wa annahum ilayhi raaji'oon
Yaa banee israa'eela udhkuroo ni'matiyal-latee an'amtu alaykum wa annee faddaltukum alal-aalameen
Wattaqoo yawman laa tajzee nafsun an nafsin shay'an wa laa yuqbalu minhaa shafaa'atun wa laa yu'ukhadhu minhaa adlun wa laa hum yunsaroon
Wa idh najjaynaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-adhaabi yudhabbihoona abnaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaa'akum wa fee dhaalikum balaa'un min rabbikum azeem
Wa idh faraqnaa bikumul-bahra fa-anjaynaakum wa aghraqnaa aala fir'awna wa antum tanzuroon
Wa idh waa'adnaa moosaa arba'eena laylatan thumma ittakhadhtumul-ijla min ba'dihi wa antum zaalimoon
Thumma afawnaa ankum min ba'di dhaalika la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa idh aataynaa moosal-kitaaba wal-furqaana la-allakum tahtadoon

Wa idh qaala moosaa liqawmihi yaa qawmi innakum zalamtum anfusakum biaattikhaadhikumul-ijla fatooboo ilaa baari'ikum faqtuloo anfusakum dhaalikum khayrun lakum inda baari'ikum fataaba alaykum innahu huwat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Wa idh qultum yaa moosaa lan nu'mina laka hattaa naraa Allaaha jahratan fa-akhadhatkumus-saa'iqatu wa antum tanzuroon
Thumma ba'athnaakum min ba'di mawtikum la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa zallalnaa alaykumul-ghamaama wa anzalnaa alaykumul-manna was-salwaa kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa maa zalamoonaa wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Wa idh qulnaa udkhuloo haadhihil-qaryata fakuloo minhaa haythu shi'tum raghadan wadkhulul-baaba sujjadan wa qooloo hittatun naghfir lakum khataayaakum wa sanazeedul-muhsineen
Fabaddalal-ladheena zalamoo qawlan ghayral-ladhee qeela lahum fa-anzalnaa alal-ladheena zalamoo rijzan minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon

Wa idh istasqaa moosaa liqawmihi faqulnaa idrib bi-asaakal-hajara fanfajarat minhu ithnataa ashrata aynan qad alima kullu unaasin mashrabahum kuloo washraboo min rizqi Allaahi wa laa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen

Wa idhi qultum yaa moosaa lan nasbira alaa ta'aamin waahidin faad'u lanaa rabbaka yukhrij lanaa mimmaa tunbitul-ardu min baqlihaa wa qiththaa'ihaa wa foomihaa wa adasihaa wa basalihaa qaala atastabdiloonal-ladhee huwa adnaa billadhee huwa khayrun ihbitoo misran fa-inna lakum maa sa'altum wa duribat alayhimudh-dhillatu wal-maskanatu wa baa'oo bighadabin mina Allaahi dhaalika bi-annahum kaanoo yakfuroona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa yaqtuloonan-nabiyyeena bighayril-haqqi dhaalika bimaa asaw wa kaanoo ya'tadoon

Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo wan-nasaaraa was-saabi'eena man aamana Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa amila saalihan falahum ajruhum inda rabbihim wa laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Wa idh akhadhnaa meethaaqakum wa rafa'naa fawqakumut-toora khudhoo maa aataynaakum biquwwatin wadhkuroo maa feehi la-allakum tattaqoon
Thumma tawallaytum min ba'di dhaalika falawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu lakuntum minal-khaasireen
Wa laqad alimtumul-ladheena i'tadaw minkum fis-sabti faqulnaa lahum koonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
Faja'alnaahaa nakaalan limaa bayna yadayhaa wa maa khalfahaa wa maw'izatan lilmuttaqeen
Wa idh qaala moosaa liqawmihi innallaaha ya'murukum an tadhbahoo baqaratan qaaloo atattakhidhunaa huzuwan qaala a'oodhu Billaahi an akoona minal-jaahileen
Qaalud-u lanaa rabbaka yubayyin lanaa maa hiya qaala innahu yaqoolu innahaa baqaratun laa faaridun wa laa bikrun awaanun bayna dhaalika faaf'aloo maa tu'maroon
Qaalud-u lanaa rabbaka yubayyin lanaa maa lawnuhaa qaala innahu yaqoolu innahaa baqaratun safraa'u faaqi'un lawnuhaa tasurrun-naazireen
Qaalud-u lanaa rabbaka yubayyin lanaa maa hiya innal-baqara tashaabaha alaynaa wa innaa in shaa'a Allaahu lamuhtadoon
Qaala innahu yaqoolu innahaa baqaratun laa dhaloolun tutheerul-arda wa laa tasqil-hartha musallamatun laa shiyata feehaa qaalul-aana ji'ta bil-haqqi fadhabahoohaa wa maa kaadoo yaf'aloon
Wa idh qataltum nafsan faddaara'tum feehaa Wallaahu mukhrijun maa kuntum taktumoon
Faqulnaa idriboohu biba'dihaa kadhaalika yuhyee Allaahul-mawtaa wa yureekum aayaatihi la-allakum ta'qiloon

Thumma qasat quloobukum min ba'di dhaalika fahiya kal-hijaarati aw ashaddu qaswatan wa inna minal-hijaarati lamaa yatafajjaru minhul-anhaaru wa inna minhaa lamaa yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhul-maa'u wa inna minhaa lamaa yahbitu min khashyati Allaahi wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
Afatatma'oona an yu'minoo lakum wa qad kaana fareequn minhum yasma'oona kalaama Allaahi thumma yuharrifoonahu min ba'di maa aqaloohu wa hum ya'lamoon
Wa idhaa laqul-ladheena aamanoo qaaloo aamannaa wa idhaa khalaa ba'duhum ilaa ba'din qaaloo atuhaddithoonahum bimaa fataha Allaahu alaykum liyuhaajjookum bihi inda rabbikum afalaa ta'qiloon
Awalaa ya'lamoona annallaaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
Wa minhum ummiyyoona laa ya'lamoonal-kitaaba illaa amaaniyya wa in hum illaa yazunnoon

Fawaylun lilladheena yaktuboonal-kitaaba bi-aydeehim thumma yaqooloona haadhaa min indi Allaahi liyashtaroo bihi thamanan qaleelan fawaylun lahum mimmaa katabat aydeehim wa waylun lahum mimmaa yaksiboon
Wa qaaloo lan tamassanan-naaru illaa ayyaaman ma'doodatan qul aattakhadhtum indallaahi ahdan falan yukhlifa Allaahu ahdahu am taqooloona alaa Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Balaa man kasaba sayyi'atan wa ahaatat bihi khatee'atuhu fa-ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon

Wa idh akhadhnaa meethaaqa banee israa'eela laa ta'budoona illaa Allaaha wa bil-waalidayni ihsaanan wa dhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wa qooloo lin-naasi husnan wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata thumma tawallaytum illaa qaleelan minkum wa antum mu'ridoon
Wa idh akhadhnaa meethaaqakum laa tasfikoona dimaa'akum wa laa tukhrijoona anfusakum min diyaarikum thumma aqrartum wa antum tashhadoon

Thumma antum haa'ulaa'i taqtuloona anfusakum wa tukhrijoona fareeqan minkum min diyaarihim tazaaharoona alayhim bil-ithmi wal-udwaani wa in ya'tookum usaaraa tufaadoohum wa huwa muharramun alaykum ikhraajuhum a fatu'minoona biba'dil-kitaabi wa takfuroona biba'din famaa jazaa'u man yaf'alu dhaalika minkum illaa khizyun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa yawmal-qiyaamati yuraddoona ilaa ashaddil-adhaabi wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena ishtaraw al-hayaatad-dunyaa bil-aakhirati falaa yukhaffafu anhumul-adhaabu wa laa hum yunsaroon

Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba wa qaffaynaa min ba'dihi bir-rusuli wa aataynaa eesab-na maryamal-bayyinaati wa ayyadnaahu biroohil-qudusi afakullamaa jaa'akum rasoolun bimaa laa tahwaa anfusukum istakbartum fafareeqan kadhdhabtum wa fareeqan taqtuloon
Wa qaaloo quloobunaa ghulfun bal la-anahumu Allaahu bikufrihim faqaleelan maa yu'minoon

Wa lammaa jaa'ahum kitaabun min indi Allaahi musaddiqun limaa ma'ahum wa kaanoo min qablu yastaftihoona alal-ladheena kafaroo falammaa jaa'ahum maa arafoo kafaroo bihi fala'natu Allaahi alal-kaafireen

Bi'sa mash-taraw bihi anfusahum an yakfuroo bimaa anzala Allaahu baghyan an yunazzila Allaahu min fadlih alaa man yashaa'u min ibaadihi fabaa'oo bighadabin alaa ghadabin wa lilkaafireena adhaabun muheen

Wa idhaa qeela lahum aaminoo bimaa anzala Allaahu qaaloo nu'minu bimaa unzila alaynaa wa yakfuroona bimaa waraa'ahu wa huwal-haqqu musaddiqan limaa ma'ahum qul falima taqtuloona anbiyaa'a Allaahi min qablu in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa laqad jaa'akum moosaa bil-bayyinaati thumma ittakhadhtumul-ijla min ba'dihi wa antum zaalimoon

Wa idh akhadhnaa meethaaqakum wa rafa'naa fawqakumut-toora khudhoo maa aataynaakum biquwwatin wasma'oo qaaloo sami'naa wa asaynaa wa ushriboo fee quloobihimul-ijla bikufrihim qul bi'samaa ya'murukum bihi eemaanukum in kuntum mu'mineen
Qul in kaanat lakumud-daarul-aakhiratu indallaahi khaalisatan min doonin-naasi fatamannaw al-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
Wa lan yatamannawhu abadan bimaa qaddamat aydeehim Wallaahu aleemun biz-zaalimeen

Wa latajidannahum ahrasan-naasi alaa hayaatin wa minal-ladheena ashrakoo yawaddu ahaduhum law yu'ammaru alfa sanatin wa maa huwa bimuzahzihihi minal-adhaabi an yu'ammara Wallaahu baseerun bimaa ya'maloon
Qul man kaana aduwwan lijibreela fa-innahu nazzalahu alaa qalbika bi-idhni Allaahi musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi wa hudan wa bushraa lilmu'mineen
Man kaana aduwwan Lillaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa rusulihi wa jibreela wa meekaala fa-innallaaha aduwwun lilkaafireen
Wa laqad anzalnaa ilayka aayaatin bayyinaatin wa maa yakfuru bihaa illal-faasiqoon
Awakullamaa aahadoo ahdan nabadhahu fareequn minhum bal aktharuhum laa yu'minoon
Wa lammaa jaa'ahum rasoolun min indi Allaahi musaddiqun limaa ma'ahum nabadha fareequn minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba kitaaba Allaahi waraa'a zuhoorihim ka'annahum laa ya'lamoon

Wattaba'oo maa tatlush-shayaateenu alaa mulki sulaymaana wa maa kafara sulaymaanu wa laakinnash-shayaateena kafaroo yu'allimoonan-naasas-sihra wa maa unzila alal-malakayni bibaabila haaroota wa maaroota wa maa yu'allimaani min ahadin hattaa yaqoolaa innamaa nahnu fitnatun falaa takfur fayata'allamoona minhumaa maa yufarriqoona bihi baynal-mar'i wa zawjihi wa maa hum bidaarreena bihi min ahadin illaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa yata'allamoona maa yadurruhum wa laa yanfa'uhum wa laqad alimoo lamani ishtaraahu maa lahu fil-aakhirati min khalaaqin wa labi'sa maa sharaw bihi anfusahum law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Wa law annahum aamanoo wattaqaw lamathoobatun min indi Allaahi khayrun law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqooloo raa'inaa wa qoolun-zurnaa wasma'oo wa lilkaafireena adhaabun aleem
Maa yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi wa lal-mushrikeena an yunazzala alaykum min khayrin min rabbikum Wallaahu yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashaa'u Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem
Maa nansakh min aayatin aw nunsihaa na'ti bikhayrin minhaa aw mithlihaa alam ta'lam annallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Alam ta'lam annallaaha lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa lakum min doonillaahi min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Am tureedoona an tas'aloo rasoolakum kamaa su'ila moosaa min qablu wa man yatabaddalil-kufra bil-eemaani faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel

Wadda katheerun min ahlil-kitaabi law yaruddoonakum min ba'di eemaanikum kuffaaran hasadan min indi anfusihim min ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul-haqqu fa'foo wasfahoo hattaa ya'tiya Allaahu bi-amrihi innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata wa maa tuqaddimoo li'nfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu indallaahi innallaaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Wa qaaloo lan yadkhulal-jannata illaa man kaana hoodan aw nasaaraa tilka amaaniyyuhum qul haatoo burhaanakum in kuntum saadiqeen
Balaa man aslama wajhahu Lillaahi wa huwa muhsinun falahu ajruhu inda rabbihi wa laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon

Wa qaalatil-yahoodu laysatin-nasaaraa alaa shay'in wa qaalatin-nasaaraa laysatil-yahoodu alaa shay'in wa hum yatloonal-kitaaba kadhaalika qaalal-ladheena laa ya'lamoona mithla qawlihim fa-Allaahu yahkumu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon

Wa man azlamu mimman mana'a masaajida Allaahi an yudhkara feehas-muhu wa sa'aa fee kharaabihaa ulaa'ika maa kaana lahum an yadkhuloohaa ilaa khaa'ifeena lahum fid-dunyaa khizyun wa lahum fil-aakhirati adhaabun azeem
Wa Lillaahil-mashriqu wal-maghribu fa-aynamaa tuwalloo fathamma wajhu Allaahi innallaaha waasi'un aleem
Wa qaalut-takhadha Allaahu waladan subhaanahu bal lahu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi kullun lahu qaanitoon
Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ardi wa idhaa qadaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon

Wa qaalal-ladheena laa ya'lamoona lawlaa yukallimunaa Allaahu aw ta'teenaa aayatun kadhaalika qaalal-ladheena min qablihim mithla qawlihim tashaabahat quloobuhum qad bayyannal-aayaati liqawmin yooqinoon
Innaa arsalnaaka bil-haqqi basheeran wa nadheeran wa laa tus'alu an ashaabil-jaheem

Wa lan tardaa ankal-yahoodu wa lan-nasaaraa hattaa tattabi'a millatahum qul inna hudaa Allaahi huwal-hudaa wa la-ini ittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum ba'dal-ladhee jaa'aka minal-ilmi maa laka mina Allaahi min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Al-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yatloonahu haqqa tilaawatihi ulaa'ika yu'minoona bihi wa man yakfur bihi fa-ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Yaa banee israa'eela udhkuroo ni'matiyal-latee an'amtu alaykum wa annee faddaltukum alal-aalameen
Wattaqoo yawman laa tajzee nafsun an nafsin shay'an wa laa yuqbalu minhaa adlun wa laa tanfa'uhaa shafaa'atun wa laa hum yunsaroon
Wa idh ibtalaa ibraaheema rabbuhu bikalimaatin fa-atammahunna qaala innee jaa'iluka lin-naasi imaaman qaala wa min dhurriyyatee qaala laa yanaalu ahdiz-zaalimeen

Wa idh ja'alnal-bayta mathaabatan lin-naasi wa amnan wattakhidhoo min maqaami ibraaheema musallan wa ahidnaa ilaa ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela an tahhiraa baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-aakifeena war-rukka'is-sujood

Wa idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbi ij'al haadhaa baladan aaminan warzuq ahlahu minath-thamaraati man aamana minhum Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri qaala wa man kafara fa-umatti'uhu qaleelan thumma adtarruhu ilaa adhaabin-naari wa bi'sal-maseer
Wa idh yarfa'u ibraaheemul-qawaa'ida minal-bayti wa ismaa'eelu rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa innaka antas-samee'ul-aleem
Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinaa ummatan muslimatan laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub alaynaa innaka antat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Rabbanaa wab'ath feehim rasoolan minhum yatloo alayhim aayaatika wa yu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa yuzakkeehim innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa man yarghabu an millati ibraaheema illaa man safiha nafsahu wa laqadi istafaynaahu fid-dunyaa wa innahu fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
Idh qaala lahu rabbuhu aslim qaala aslamtu lirabbil-aalameen
Wa wassaa bihaa ibraaheemu baneehi wa ya'qoobu yaa baniyya innallaaha istafaa lakumud-deena falaa tamootunna illaa wa antum muslimoon

Am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh hadara ya'qoobal-mawtu idh qaala libaneehi maa ta'budoona min ba'dee qaaloo na'budu ilahaka wa ilaaha aabaa'ika ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa ilahan waahidan wa nahnu lahu muslimoon
Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahaa maa kasabat wa lakum maa kasabtum wa laa tus'aloona ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa qaaloo koonoo hoodan aw nasaaraa tahtadoo qul bal millata ibraaheema haneefan wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen

Qooloo aamannaa Billaahi wa maa unzila ilaynaa wa maa unzila ilaa ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wal-asbaati wa maa ootiya moosaa wa eesaa wa maa ootiyan-nabiyyoona min rabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wa nahnu lahu muslimoon
Fa-in aamanoo bimithli maa aamantum bihi faqadi ihtadaw wa in tawallaw fa-innamaa hum fee shiqaaqin fasayakfeekahumu Allaahu wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Sibghata Allaahi wa man ahsanu mina Allaahi sibghatan wa nahnu lahu aabidoon
Qul atuhaajjoonanaa fee Allaahi wa huwa rabbunaa wa rabbukum wa lanaa a'maalunaa wa lakum a'maalukum wa nahnu lahu mukhlisoon

Am taqooloona inna ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wal-asbaata kaanoo hoodan aw nasaaraa qul a'antum a'lamu ami Allaahu wa man azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan indahu mina Allaahi wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahaa maa kasabat wa lakum maa kasabtum wa laa tus'aloona ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Sayaqoolus-sufahaa'u minan-naasi maa Wallaahum an qiblatihimul-latee kaanoo alayhaa qul Lillaahil-mashriqu wal-maghribu yahdee man yashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqeem

Wa kadhalika ja'alnaakum ummatan wasatan litakoonoo shuhadaa'a alan-naasi wa yakoonar-rasoolu alaykum shaheedan wa maa ja'alnal-qiblatal-latee kunta alayhaa illaa lina'lama man yattabi'ur-rasoola mimman yanqalibu alaa aqibayhi wa in kaanat lakabeeratan illaa alal-ladheena hadaa Allaahu wa maa kaana Allaahu liyudee'a eemaanakum innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofun Raheem

Qad naraa taqalluba wajhika fis-samaa'i falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardaahaa fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraami wa haythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahu wa innal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba laya'lamoona annahul-haqqu min rabbihim wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ya'maloon

Wa la-in ataytal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba bikulli aayatin maa tabi'oo qiblataka wa maa anta bitaabi'in qiblatahum wa maa ba'duhum bitaabi'in qiblata ba'din wa la-ini ittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum min ba'di maa jaa'aka minal-ilmi innaka idhan laminaz-zaalimeen
Al-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona abnaa'ahum wa inna fareeqan minhum layaktumoonal-haqqa wa hum ya'lamoon
Al-haqqu min rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Wa likullin wijhatun huwa muwalleehaa fastabiqul-khayraati ayna maa takoonoo ya'ti bikumu Allaahu jamee'an innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa min haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraami wa innahu lalhaqqu min rabbika wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon

Wa min haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraami wa haythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahu li-allaa yakoona lin-naasi alaykum hujjatun illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawnee wa li-atimma ni'matee alaykum wa la-allakum tahtadoon
Kamaa arsalnaa feekum rasoolan minkum yatloo alaykum aayaatinaa wa yuzakkeekum wa yu'allimukumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa yu'allimukum maa lam takoonoo ta'lamoon
Fadhkuroonee adhkurkum washkuroo lee wa laa takfuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ista'eenoo bis-sabri was-salaati innallaaha ma'as-saabireen
Wa laa taqooloo liman yuqtalu fee sabeelillaahi amwaatun bal ahyaa'un wa laakin laa tash'uroon
Wa lanabluwannakum bishay'in minal-khawfi wal-joo'i wa naqsin minal-amwli wal-anfusi wath-thamaraati wa bashshiris-saabireen
Al-ladheena idhaa asaabathum museebatun qaaloo innaa Lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon
Ulaa'ika alayhim salawaatun min rabbihim wa rahmatun wa ulaa'ika humul-muhtadoon
Innas-safaa wal-marwata min sha'aa'iri Allaahi faman hajjal-bayta aw i'tamara falaa junaaha alayhi an yattawwafa bihimaa wa man tatawwa'a khayran fa-innallaaha shaakirun aleem
Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzalnaa minal-bayyinaati wal-hudaa min ba'di maa bayyannaahu lin-naasi fil-kitaabi ulaa'ika yal-anuhumu Allaahu wa yal-anuhumul-laa'inoon
Illal-ladheena taaboo wa aslahoo wa bayyanoo fa-ulaa'ika atoobu alayhim wa anat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa maatoo wa hum kuffaarun ulaa'ika alayhim la'natu Allaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma'een
Khaalideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu anhumul-adhaabu wa laa hum yunzaroon
Wa ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun laa ilaaha illaa huwar-Rahmaanur-Raheem

Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wal-fulkil-latee tajree fil-bahri bimaa yanfa'un-naasa wa maa anzala Allaahu minas-samaa'i min maa'in fa-ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa wa baththa feehaa min kulli daabbatin wa tasreefir-riyaahi was-sahaabil-musakhkhari baynas-samaa'i wal-ardi la-aayaatin liqawmin ya'qiloon

Wa minan-naasi man yattakhidhu min doonillaahi andaadan yuhibboonahum kahubbi Allaahi wal-ladheena aamanoo ashaddu hubban Lillaahi wa law yaral-ladheena zalamoo idh yarawnal-adhaaba annal-quwwata Lillaahi jamee'an wa annallaaha shadeedul-adhaab
Idh tabarra'al-ladheena uttubi'oo minal-ladheena ittaba'oo wa ra'aw al-adhaaba wa taqatta'at bihimul-asbaab
Wa qaalal-ladheena ittaba'oo law anna lanaa karratan fanatabarra'a minhum kamaa tabarra'oo minnaa kadhaalika yureehimu Allaahu a'maalahum hasaraatin alayhim wa maa hum bikhaarijeena minan-naar
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu kuloo mimmaa fil-ardi halaalan tayyiban wa laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaani innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen
Innamaa ya'murukum bis-soo'i wal-fahshaa'i wa an taqooloo alaa Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa idhaa qeela lahum ittabi'oo maa anzala Allaahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa alfaynaa alayhi aabaa'anaa awalaw kaana aabaa'uuhum laa ya'qiloona shay'an wa laa yahtadoon
Wa mathalul-ladheena kafaroo kamathalil-ladhee yan'iqu bimaa laa yasma'u illaa du'aa'an wa nidaa'an summun bukmun umyun fahum laa ya'qiloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum washkuroo Lillaahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
Innamaa harrama alaykumul-maytata wad-dama wa lahmal-khinzeeri wa maa uhilla bihi lighayri Allaahi famani udturra ghayra baaghin wa laa aadin falaa ithma alayhi innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem

Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzala Allaahu minal-kitaabi wa yashtaroona bihi thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika maa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim illan-naara wa laa yukallimuhumu Allaahu yawmal-qiyaamati wa laa yuzakkeehim wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena ishtaraw ad-dalaalata bil-hudaa wal-adhaaba bil-maghfirati famaa asbarahum alan-naar
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha nazzalal-kitaaba bil-haqqi wa innal-ladheena ikhtalafoo fil-kitaabi lafee shiqaaqin ba'eed

Laysal-birra an tuwalloo wujoohakum qibalal-mashriqi wal-maghribi wa laakinnal-birra man aamana Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wal-malaa'ikati wal-kitaabi wan-nabiyyeena wa aatal-maala alaa hubbihi dhawil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeena wabnas-sabeeli was-saa'ileena wa fir-riqaabi wa aqaamas-salaata wa aataz-zakaata wal-moofoona bi-ahdihim idhaa aahadoo was-saabireena fil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i wa heenal-ba'si ulaa'ikal-ladheena sadaqoo wa ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba alaykumul-qisaasu fil-qatlal-hurru bil-hurri wal-abdu bil-abdi wal-unthaa bil-unthaa faman ufiya lahu min akheehi shay'un fattibaa'un bil-ma'roofi wa adaa'un ilayhi bi-ihsaanin dhaalika takhfeefun min rabbikum wa rahmatun famani i'tadaa ba'da dhaalika falahu adhaabun aleem
Wa lakum fil-qisaasi hayaatun yaa ulil-albaabi la-allakum tattaqoon
Kutiba alaykum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu in taraka khayran al-wasiyyatu lilwaalidayni wal-aqrabeena bil-ma'roofi haqqan alal-muttaqeen
Faman baddalahu ba'damaa sami'ahu fa-innamaa ithmuhu alal-ladheena yubaddiloonahu innallaaha samee'un aleem
Faman khaafa min moosin janafan aw ithman fa-aslaha baynahum falaa ithma alayhi innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba alaykumus-siyaamu kamaa kutiba alal-ladheena min qablikum la-allakum tattaqoon

Ayyaaman ma'doodaatin faman kaana minkum mareedan aw alaa safarin fa-iddatun min ayyaamin ukhara wa alal-ladheena yuteeqoonahu fidyatun ta'aamu miskeenin faman tatawwa'a khayran fahuwa khayrun lahu wa an tasoomoo khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon

Shahru ramadaanal-ladhee unzila feehil-qur'aanu hudan lin-naasi wa bayyinaatin minal-hudaa wal-furqaani faman shahida minkumush-shahra falyasumhu wa man kaana mareedan aw alaa safarin fa-iddatun min ayyaamin ukhara yureedu Allaahu bikumul-yusra wa laa yureedu bikumul-usra wa litukmilul-iddata wa litukabbiroo Allaaha alaa maa hadaakum wa la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa idhaa sa'alaka ibaadee annee fa-innee qareebun ujeebu da'watad-daa'i idhaa da'aani falyastajeeboo lee wa lyu'minoo bee la-allahum yarshudoon

Uhilla lakum laylatas-siyaamir-rafathu ilaa nisaa'ikum hunna libaasun lakum wa antum libaasun lahunna alima Allaahu annakum kuntum takhtaanoona anfusakum fataaba alaykum wa afaa ankum fal-aana baashiroohunna wabtaghoo maa kataba Allaahu lakum wa kuloo washraboo hattaa yatabayyana lakumul-khaytul-abyadu minal-khaytil-aswadi minal-fajri thumma atimmus-siyaama ilal-layli wa laa tubaashiroohunna wa antum aakifoona fil-masaajidi tilka hudoodu Allaahi falaa taqraboohaa kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu aayaatihi lin-naasi la-allahum yattaqoon
Wa laa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili wa tudloo bihaa ilal-hukkaami lita'kuloo fareeqan min amwaalin-naasi bil-ithmi wa antum ta'lamoon

Yas'aloonaka anil-ahillati qul hiya mawaaqeetu lin-naasi wal-hajji wa laysal-birru bi-an ta'tul-buyoota min zuhoorihaa wa laakinnal-birra manit-taqaa wa tul-buyoota min abwaabihaa wattaqoo Allaaha la-allakum tuflihoon
Wa qaatiloo fee sabeelillaahil-ladheena yuqaatiloonakum wa laa ta'tadoo innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen

Waaqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum wa akhrijoohum min haythu akhrajookum wal-fitnatu ashaddu minal-qatli wa laa tuqaatiloohum indal-masjidil-haraami hattaa yuqaatilookum feehi fa-in qaatalookum faqtuloohum kadhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
Fa-ini intahaw fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Wa qaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatun wa yakoonad-deenu Lillaahi fa-ini intahaw falaa udwaana illaa alaz-zaalimeen
Ash-shahrul-haraamu bish-shahril-haraami wal-hurumaatu qisaasun famani i'tadaa alaykum fa'tadoo alayhi bimithli ma-tadaa alaykum wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen
Wa anfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi wa laa tulqoo bi-aydeekum ilat-tahlukati wa ahsinoo innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen

Wa atimmul-hajja wal-umrata Lillaahi fa-in uhsirtum famas-taysara minal-hadyi wa laa tahliqoo ru'oosakum hattaa yablughal-hadyu mahillahu faman kaana minkum mareedan aw bihi adhan min ra'sihi fafidyatun min siyaamin aw sadaqatin aw nusukin fa-idhaa amintum faman tamatta'a bil-umrati ilal-hajji famas-taysara minal-hadyi faman lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaamin fil-hajji wa sab'atin idhaa raja'tum tilka asharatun kaamilatun dhaalika liman lam yakun ahluhu haadiril-masjidil-haraami wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-iqaab

Al-hajju ashhurun ma'loomaatun faman farada feehinnal-hajja falaa rafatha wa laa fusooqa wa laa jidaala fil-hajji wa maa taf'aloo min khayrin ya'lamhu Allaahu wa tazawwadoo fa-inna khayraz-zaadit-taqwaa wattaqoonee yaa ulil-albaab
Laysa alaykum junaahun an tabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum fa-idhaa afadtum min arafaatin fadhkuroo Allaaha indal-mash'aril-haraami wadhkuroohu kamaa hadaakum wa in kuntum min qablihi laminad-daalleen
Thumma afeedoo min haythu afaadan-naasu wastaghfiroo Allaaha innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Fa-idhaa qadaytum manaasikakum fadhkuroo Allaaha kadhikrikum aabaa'akum aw ashadda dhikran faminan-naasi man yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa wa maa lahu fil-aakhirati min khalaaq
Wa minhum man yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa adhaaban-naar
Ulaa'ika lahum naseebun mimmaa kasaboo Wallaahu saree'ul-hisaab
Wadhkuroo Allaaha fee ayyaamin ma'doodaatin faman ta'ajjala fee yawmayni falaa ithma alayhi wa man ta'akhkhara falaa ithma alayhi limani ittaqaa wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annakum ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wa minan-naasi man yu'jibuka qawluhu fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa yushhidu Allaaha alaa maa fee qalbihi wa huwa aladdul-khisaam
Wa idhaa tawallaa sa'aa fil-ardi liyufsida feehaa wa yuhlikal-hartha wan-nasla Wallaahu laa yuhibbul-fasaad
Wa idhaa qeela lahut-taqi Allaaha akhadhathul-izzatu bil-ithmi fahasbuhu jahannamu wa labi'sal-mihaad
Wa minan-naasi man yashree nafsahu ibtighaa'a mardaati Allaahi Wallaahu ra'oofun bil-ibaad
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo udkhuloo fis-silmi kaaffatan wa laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaani innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen
Fa-in zalaltum min ba'di maa jaa'atkumul-bayyinaatu fa'lamoo annallaaha azeezun hakeem
Hal yanzuroona illaa an ya'tiyahumu Allaahu fee zulalin minal-ghamaami wal-malaa'ikatu wa qudiyal-amru wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor
Sal banee israa'eela kam aataynaahum min aayatin bayyinatin wa man yubaddil ni'matallaahi min ba'di maa jaa'athu fa-innallaaha shadeedul-iqaab
Zuyyina lilladheena kafarul-hayaatud-dunyaa wa yaskharoona minal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena ittaqaw fawqahum yawmal-qiyaamati Wallaahu yarzuqu man yashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Kaanan-naasu ummatan waahidatan faba'atha Allaahun-nabiyyeena mubashshireena wa mundhireena wa anzala ma'ahumul-kitaaba bil-haqqi liyahkuma baynan-naasi feemakh-talafoo feehi wa makh-talafa feehi illal-ladheena ootoohu min ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu baghyan baynahum fahadaa Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo limakh-talafoo feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnihi Wallaahu yahdee man yashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqeem

Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata wa lammaa ya'tikum mathalul-ladheena khalaw min qablikum massathumul-ba'saa'u wad-darraa'u wa zulziloo hattaa yaqoolar-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu mataa nasrullaahi alaa inna nasra Allaahi qareeb
Yas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoona qul maa anfaqtum min khayrin falilwaalidayni wal-aqrabeena wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli wa maa taf'aloo min khayrin fa-innallaaha bihi aleem
Kutiba alaykumul-qitaalu wa huwa kurhun lakum wa asaa an takrahoo shay'an wa huwa khayrun lakum wa asaa an tuhibboo shay'an wa huwa sharrun lakum Wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon

Yas'aloonaka anish-shahril-haraami qitaalin feehi qul qitaalun feehi kabeerun wa saddun an sabeelillaahi wa kufrun bihi wal-masjidil-haraami wa ikhraaju ahlihi minhu akbaru indallaahi wal-fitnatu akbaru minal-qatli wa laa yazaaloona yuqaatiloonakum hattaa yaruddookum an deenikum inis-tataa'oo wa man yartadid minkum an deenihi fayamut wa huwa kaafirun fa-ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haajaroo wa jaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi ulaa'ika yarjoona rahmata Allaahi Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem

Yas'aloonaka anil-khamri wal-maysiri qul feehimaa ithmun kabeerun wa manaafi'u lin-naasi wa ithmuhumaa akbaru min naf'ihimaa wa yas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoona qulil-afwa kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakumul-aayaati la-allakum tatafakkaroon

Fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa yas'aloonaka anil-yataamaa qul islaahun lahum khayrun wa in tukhaalitoohum fa-ikhwaanukum Wallaahu ya'lamul-mufsida minal-muslihi wa law shaa'a Allaahu la-a'natakum innallaaha azeezun hakeem

Wa laa tankihul-mushrikaati hattaa yu'minna wa la-amatun mu'minatun khayrun min mushrikatin wa law a'jabatkum wa laa tunkihul-mushrikeena hattaa yu'minoo wa la-abdun mu'minun khayrun min mushrikin wa law a'jabakum ulaa'ika yad'oona ilan-naari Wallaahu yad'oo ilal-jannati wal-maghfirati bi-idhnihi wa yubayyinu aayaatihi lin-naasi la-allahum yatadhakkaroon

Wa yas'aloonaka anil-maheedi qul huwa adhan fa'tazilun-nisaa fil-maheedi wa laa taqraboohunna hattaa yathurna fa-idhaa tatahharna fa'toohunna min haythu amarakumu Allaahu innallaaha yuhibbut-tawwaabeena wa yuhibbul-mutatahhireen
Nisaa'uukum harthun lakum fa'too harthakum annaa shi'tum wa qaddimoo li'nfusikum wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annakum mulaaqoohu wa bashshiril-mu'mineen
Wa laa taj'aloo Allaaha urdatan li'ymaanikum an tabarroo wa tattaqoo wa tuslihoo baynan-naasi Wallaahu samee'un aleem
Laa yu'uaakhidhukumu Allaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum wa laakin yu'uaakhidhukum bimaa kasabat quloobukum Wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
Lilladheena yu'loona min nisaa'ihim tarabbusu arba'ati ashhurin fa-in faa'oo fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Wa in azamut-talaaqa fa-innallaaha samee'un aleem

Wal-mutallaqaatu yatarabbasna bi-anfusihinna thalaathata quroo'in wa laa yahillu lahunna an yaktumna maa khalaqa Allaahu fee arhaamihinna in kunna yu'minna Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa bu'oolatuhunna ahaqqu biraddihinna fee dhaalika in araadoo islaahan wa lahunna mithlul-ladhee alayhinna bil-ma'roofi wa lir-rijaali alayhinna darajatun Wallaahu azeezun hakeem

At-talaaqu marrataani fa-imsaakun bima'roofin aw tasreehun bi-ihsaanin wa laa yahillu lakum an ta'khudhoo mimmaa aataytumoohunna shay'an illaa an yakhaafaa allaa yuqeemaa hudooda Allaahi fa-in khiftum allaa yuqeemaa hudooda Allaahi falaa junaaha alayhimaa feemaf-tadat bihi tilka hudoodu Allaahi falaa ta'tadoohaa wa man yata'adda hudooda Allaahi fa-ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

Fa-in tallaqahaa falaa tahillu lahu min ba'du hattaa tankiha zawjan ghayrahu fa-in tallaqahaa falaa junaaha alayhimaa an yataraaja'aa in zannaa an yuqeemaa hudooda Allaahi wa tilka hudoodu Allaahi yubayyinuhaa liqawmin ya'lamoon

Wa idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa fabalaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikoohunna bima'roofin aw sarrihoohunna bima'roofin wa laa tumsikoohunna diraaran lita'tadoo wa man yaf'al dhaalika faqad zalama nafsahu wa laa tattakhidhoo aayaati Allaahi huzuwan wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum wa maa anzala alaykum minal-kitaabi wal-hikmati ya'izukum bihi wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem

Wa idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa fabalaghna ajalahunna falaa ta'duloohunna an yankihna azwaajahunna idhaa taraadaw baynahum bil-ma'roofi dhaalika yoo'azu bihi man kaana minkum yu'minu Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri dhaalikum azkaa lakum wa atharu Wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon

Wal-waalidaatu yurdi'na awlaadahunna hawlayni kaamilayni liman araada an yutimmar-radaa'ata wa alal-mawloodi lahu rizquhunna wa kiswatuhunna bil-ma'roofi laa tukallafu nafsun illaa wus'ahaa laa tudaarra wa-datun biwaladihaa wa laa mawloodun lahu biwaladihi wa alal-waarithi mithlu dhaalika fa-in araadaa fisaalan an taraadin minhumaa wa tashaawurin falaa junaaha alayhimaa wa in aradtum an tastardi'oo awlaadakum falaa junaaha alaykum idhaa sallamtum maa aataytum bil-ma'roofi wattaqoo Allaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer

Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wa yadharoona azwaajan yatarabbasna bi-anfusihinna arba'ata ashhurin wa ashran fa-idhaa balaghna ajalahunna falaa junaaha alaykum feemaa fa-alna fee anfusihinna bil-ma'roofi Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer

Wa laa junaaha alaykum feemaa arradtum bihi min khitbatin-nisaa aw aknantum fee anfusikum alima Allaahu annakum satadhkuroonahunna wa laakin laa tuwaa'idoohunna sirran illaa an taqooloo qawlan ma'roofan wa laa ta'zimoo uqdatan-nikaahi hattaa yablughal-kitaabu ajalahu wa'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu maa fee anfusikum fahdharoohu wa'lamoo annallaaha ghafoorun haleem

Laa junaaha alaykum in tallaqtumun-nisaa maa lam tamassoohunna aw tafridoo lahunna fareedatan wa matti'oohunna alal-moosi'i qadaruhu wa alal-muqtiri qadaruhu mataa'an bil-ma'roofi haqqan alal-muhsineen

Wa in tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna wa qad faradtum lahunna fareedatan fanisfu maa faradtum illaa an ya'foona aw ya'fuwal-ladhee biyadihi uqdatun-nikaahi wa an ta'foo aqrabu lit-taqwaa wa laa tansaw al-fadla baynakum innallaaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Haafizoo alas-salawaati was-salaatil-wustaa wa qoomoo Lillaahi qaaniteen
Fa-in khiftum farijaalan aw rukbaanan fa-idhaa amintum fadhkuroo Allaaha kamaa allamakum maa lam takoonoo ta'lamoon

Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wa yadharoona azwaajan wasiyyatan li'zwaajihim mataa'an ilal-hawli ghayra ikhraajin fa-in kharajna falaa junaaha alaykum fee maa fa-alna fee anfusihinna min ma'roofin Wallaahu azeezun hakeem
Wa lilmutallaqaati mataa'un bil-ma'roofi haqqan alal-muttaqeen
Kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakum aayaatihi la-allakum ta'qiloon

Alam tara ilal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim wa hum uloofun hadharal-mawti faqaala lahumu Allaahu mootoo thumma ahyaahum innallaaha ladhoo fadlin alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Wa qaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi wa'lamoo annallaaha samee'un aleem
Man dhal-ladhee yuqridu Allaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa'ifahu lahu ad'aafan katheeratan Wallaahu yaqbidu wa yabsutu wa ilayhi turja'oon

Alam tara ilal-mala'i min banee israa'eela min ba'di moosaa idh qaaloo linabiyyin lahum ib'ath lanaa malikan nuqaatil fee sabeelillaahi qaala hal asaytum in kutiba alaykumul-qitaalu allaa tuqaatiloo qaaloo wa maa lanaa allaa nuqaatila fee sabeelillaahi wa qad ukhrijnaa min diyaarinaa wa abnaa'inaa falammaa kutiba alayhimul-qitaalu tawallaw illaa qaleelan minhum Wallaahu aleemun biz-zaalimeen

Wa qaala lahum nabiyyuhum innallaaha qad ba'atha lakum taaloota malikan qaaloo annaa yakoonu lahul-mulku alaynaa wa nahnu ahaqqu bil-mulki minhu wa lam yu'ta sa'atan minal-maali qaala innallaaha istafaahu alaykum wa zaadahu bastatan fil-ilmi wal-jismi Wallaahu yu'tee mulkahu man yashaa'u Wallaahu waasi'un aleem

Wa qaala lahum nabiyyuhum inna aayata mulkihi an ya'tiyakumut-taabootu feehi sakeenatun min rabbikum wa baqiyyatun mimmaa taraka aalu moosaa wa aalu haaroona tahmiluhul-malaa'ikatu inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan lakum in kuntum mu'mineen

Falammaa fasala taalootu bil-junoodi qaala innallaaha mubtaleekum binaharin faman shariba minhu falaysa minnee wa man lam yat'amhu fa-innahu minnee illaa manigh-tarafa ghurfatan biyadihi fashariboo minhu illaa qaleelan minhum falammaa jaawazahu huwa wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu qaaloo laa taaqata lanal-yawma bijaaloota wa junoodihi qaalal-ladheena yazunnoona annahum mulaaqoo Allaahi kam min fi'atin qaleelatin ghalabat fi'atan katheeratan bi-idhni Allaahi Wallaahu ma'as-saabireen
Wa lammaa barazoo lijaaloota wa junoodihi qaaloo rabbanaa afrigh alaynaa sabran wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa alal-qawmil-kaafireen

Fahazamoohum bi-idhni Allaahi wa qatala daawoodu jaaloota wa aataahu Allaahul-mulka wal-hikmata wa allamahu mimmaa yashaa'u wa lawlaa daf'u Allaahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'din lafasadatil-ardu wa laakinna Allaaha dhoo fadlin alal-aalameen
Tilka aayaatu Allaahi natloohaa alayka bil-haqqi wa innaka laminal-mursaleen

Tilkar-rusulu faddalnaa ba'dahum alaa ba'din minhum man kallama Allaahu wa rafa'a ba'dahum darajaatin wa aataynaa eesab-na maryamal-bayyinaati wa ayyadnaahu biroohil-qudusi wa law shaa'a Allaahu maq-tatalal-ladheena min ba'dihim min ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu wa lakini ikhtalafoo faminhum man aamana wa minhum man kafara wa law shaa'a Allaahu maq-tataloo wa laakinna Allaaha yaf'alu maa yureed
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaakum min qabli an ya'tiya yawmun laa bay'un feehi wa laa khullatun wa laa shafaa'atun wal-kaafiroona humuz-zaalimoon

Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawmun lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u indahu illaa bi-idhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bishay'in min ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-arda wa laa ya'ooduhu hifzuhumaa wa huwal-aliyyul-azeem
Laa ikraaha fid-deeni qad tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayyi faman yakfur bit-taaghooti wa yu'min Billaahi faqadi istamsaka bil-urwatil-wuthqaa lan-fisaama lahaa Wallaahu samee'un aleem

Allaahu waliyyul-ladheena aamanoo yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor wal-ladheena kafaroo awliyaa'uuhumut-taaghootu yukhrijoonahum minan-noor ilaz-zulumaati ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon

Alam tara ilal-ladhee haajja ibraaheema fee rabbihi an aataahu Allaahul-mulka idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbil-ladhee yuhyee wa yumeetu qaala anaa uhyee wa umeetu qaala ibraaheemu fa-innallaaha ya'tee bish-shamsi minal-mashriqi fa'ti bihaa minal-maghribi fabuhital-ladhee kafara Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen

Aw kal-ladhee marra alaa qaryatin wa hiya khaawiyatun alaa urooshihaa qaala annaa yuhyee haadhihi Allaahu ba'da mawtihaa fa-amaatahu Allaahu miaa'ata aamin thumma ba'athahu qaala kam labithta qaala labithtu yawman aw ba'da yawmin qaala bal labithta miaa'ata aamin fanzur ilaa ta'aamika wa sharaabika lam yatasannah wanzur ilaa himaarika wa linaj'alaka aayatan lin-naasi wanzur ilal-izaami kayfa nunshizuhaa thumma naksoohaa lahman falammaa tabayyana lahu qaala a'lamu annallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Wa idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbi arinee kayfa tuhyil-mawtaa qaala awalam tu'min qaala balaa wa laakin liyatma'inna qalbee qaala fakhudh arba'atan minat-tayri fasurhunna ilayka thumma ij'al alaa kulli jabalin minhunna juz'an thumma ud'uhunna ya'teenaka sa'yan wa'lam annallaaha azeezun hakeem
Mathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi kamathali habbatin anbatat sab'a sanaabila fee kulli sunbulatin miaa'atu habbatin Wallaahu yudaa'ifu liman yashaa'u Wallaahu waasi'un aleem
Al-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi thumma laa yutbi'oona maa anfaqoo mannan wa laa adhan lahum ajruhum inda rabbihim wa laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Qawlun ma'roofun wa maghfiratun khayrun min sadaqatin yatba'uhaa adhan Wallaahu ghaniyyun haleem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tubtiloo sadaqaatikum bil-manni wal-adhaa kal-ladhee yunfiqu maalahu ri'aa'an-naasi wa laa yu'minu Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri famathaluhu kamathali safwaanin alayhi turaabun fa-asaabahu wabilun fatarakahu saldan laa yaqdiroona alaa shay'in mimmaa kasaboo Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen

Wa mathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahumu ibtighaa'a mardaati Allaahi wa tathbeetan min anfusihim kamathali jannatin birabwatin asaabahaa wabilun fa-aatat ukulahaa di'fayni fa-in lam yusibhaa wabilun fatallun Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer

Ayawaddu ahadukum an takoona lahu jannatun min nakheelin wa a'naabin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahu feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wa asaabahul-kibaru wa lahu dhurriyyatun du'afaa'u fa-asaabahaa i'saarun feehi naarun fahtaraqat kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakumul-aayaati la-allakum tatafakkaroon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo min tayyibaati maa kasabtum wa mimmaa akhrajnaa lakum minal-ardi wa laa tayammamul-khabeetha minhu tunfiqoona wa lastum bi-aakhidheehi illaa an tughmidoo feehi wa'lamoo annallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
Ash-shaytaanu ya'idukumul-faqra wa ya'murukum bil-fahshaa'i Wallaahu ya'idukum maghfiratan minhu wa fadlan Wallaahu waasi'un aleem
Yu'til-hikmata man yashaa'u wa man yu'tal-hikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeran wa maa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
Wa maa anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nadhartum min nadhrin fa-innallaaha ya'lamuhu wa maa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
In tubdus-sadaqaati fani'immaa hiya wa in tukhfoohaa wa tu'toohal-fuqaraa'a fahuwa khayrun lakum wa yukaffiru ankum min sayyi'aatikum Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer

Laysa alayka hudaahum wa laakinna Allaaha yahdee man yashaa'u wa maa tunfiqoo min khayrin fali'anfusikum wa maa tunfiqoona illab-tighaa'a wajhi Allaahi wa maa tunfiqoo min khayrin yuwaffa ilaykum wa antum laa tuzlamoon

Lilfuqaraa'il-ladheena uhsiroo fee sabeelillaahi laa yastatee'oona darban fil-ardi yahsabuhumul-jaahilu aghniyaa'a minat-ta'affufi ta'rifuhum biseemaahum laa yas'aloonan-naasa ilhaafan wa maa tunfiqoo min khayrin fa-innallaaha bihi aleem
Al-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum bil-layli wan-nahaari sirran wa alaaniyatan falahum ajruhum inda rabbihim wa laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon

Al-ladheena ya'kuloonar-ribaa laa yaqoomoona illaa kamaa yaqoomul-ladhee yatakhabbatuhush-shaytaanu minal-massi dhaalika bi-annahum qaaloo innamal-bay'u mithlur-ribaa wa ahalla Allaahul-bay'a wa harramar-ribaa faman jaa'ahu maw'izatun min rabbihi fantahaa falahu maa salafa wa amruhu ilaa Allaahi wa man aada fa-ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Yamhaqu Allaahur-ribaa wa yurbis-sadaqaati Wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla kaffaarin atheem
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa aqaamus-salaata wa aataw az-zakaata lahum ajruhum inda rabbihim wa laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wa dharoo maa baqiya minar-ribaa in kuntum mu'mineen
Fa-in lam taf'aloo fa'dhanoo biharbin mina Allaahi wa rasoolihi wa in tubtum falakum ru'oosu amwaalikum laa tazlimoona wa laa tuzlamoon
Wa in kaana dhoo usratin fanaziratun ilaa maysaratin wa an tasaddaqoo khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
Wattaqoo yawman turja'oona feehi ilaa Allaahi thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsin maa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tadaayantum bidaynin ilaa ajalin musamman faktuboohu wa lyaktub baynakum kaatibun bil-adli wa laa ya'ba kaatibun an yaktuba kamaa allamahu Allaahu falyaktub wa lyumlilil-ladhee alayhil-haqqu wa lyattaqi Allaaha rabbahu wa laa yabkhas minhu shay'an fa-in kaanal-ladhee alayhil-haqqu safeehan aw da'eefan aw laa yastatee'u an yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhu bil-adli wastashhidoo shaheedayni min rijaalikum fa-in lam yakoonaa rajulayni farajulun wamra'ataani mimman tardawna minash-shuhadaa'i an tadilla ihdaahumaa fatudhakkira ihdaahumal-ukhraa wa laa ya'bash-shuhadaa'u idhaa maa du'oo wa laa tas'amoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ilaa ajalihi dhaalikum aqsatu indallaahi wa aqwamu lish-shahaadati wa adnaa allaa tartaaboo illaa an takoona tijaaratan haadiratan tudeeroonahaa baynakum falaysa alaykum junaahun allaa taktuboohaa wa ashhidoo idhaa tabaaya'tum wa laa yudaarra kaatibun wa laa shaheedun wa in taf'aloo fa-innahu fusooqun bikum wattaqoo Allaaha wa yu'allimukumu Allaahu Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem

Wa in kuntum alaa safarin wa lam tjidoo kaatiban farihaanun maqboodatun fa-in amina ba'dukum ba'dan falyu'addil-ladhee u'tumina amaanatahu wa lyattaqi Allaaha rabbahu wa laa taktumush-shahaadata wa man yaktumhaa fa-innahu aathimun qalbuhu Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona aleem

Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa in tubdoo maa fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihi Allaahu fayaghfiru liman yashaa'u wa yu'adhdhibu man yashaa'u Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Aamanar-rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minoona kullun aamana Billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa ilaykal-maseer

Laa yukallifu Allaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa alayhaa mak-tasabat rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa rabbanaa wa laa tahmil alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu alal-ladheena min qablinaa rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi wa'fu annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa alal-qawmil-kaafireen
